title: Tech scheduling availability is determined by department assignment, not role
expected: User A (dept incl. scheduling) is schedulable; User B (dept without) is not, until B's dept changes
actual: Not executed. Requires two users on the SAME role but different department assignments (one with scheduling, one without) and use of the Schedule grid to compare, plus a controlled department change.
reason: Blocked: requires provisioning two same-role users with specific department scheduling config; quick-login only exposes admin (Admin) and tech (Time Clock), and building/altering real staff+departments to compare is out of scope (must not change real staff). Not safely reproducible this session.

title: WO line clock-in is gated by per-staff 'Time Clock' setting on the staff record
expected: User C (Time Clock ON) can clock in on a labor line; User D (Time Clock OFF) has no/disabled clock-in control
actual: Confirmed the per-staff 'Time Clock' toggle exists on the Edit Staff Member record. Did NOT execute the WO-line clock-in comparison: needs two Technician-role users with the per-staff Time Clock setting ON vs OFF, each with an assigned WO containing a labor line.
reason: Blocked: requires two same-role (Technician) users differing only in per-staff Time Clock setting, plus assigned WOs with labor lines, to compare the line clock-in control. quick-login only provides admin/tech; constructing this without modifying real staff/WOs is out of scope this session.

actual: Admin (Admin role) DOES show the universal 'Clock In' control in the top header ('timer Clock In', '0.46 Hrs Today'). Could not test Service Advisor or a clockable Time Clock user, nor verify timesheet entries for three roles.
reason: Blocked: full verification needs three active users of different roles (Admin, Service Advisor, Time Clock) all with the per-staff Time Clock/clockable setting enabled, plus timesheet inspection. quick-login exposes only admin (has control) and tech (no control, likely clockable OFF); cannot provision a clockable Service Advisor without altering real staff.
